name: SendGrid
description: Twilio SendGrid is a cloud email platform with a v3 Web API for transactional and marketing email.
auth_notes: API keys created in the console are sent in an Authorization Bearer header; Basic auth uses username apikey with the key as password for some services.
gate_detail: API keys are created in the console after signup. Sources mention only a limited free trial option plus paid Email API and Marketing Campaigns plans; no permanent free plan is stated.
api_scope: Web REST API v3 at api.sendgrid.com covering email sending, templates and marketing campaigns, with SDKs in seven languages.
mcp_notes: Only a Twilio community blog tutorial on building your own SendGrid MCP server; no vendor-published server shown.
blocker_detail: Free access is described only as a limited trial; sustained production use appears to need a paid Email API plan.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the Twilio SendGrid API by creating an API Key in the Settings section of the Twilio SendGrid console
The Twilio SendGrid Web REST API v3 provides SDKs for seven different languages.
Each category provides several pricing tiers, including a free trial option with certain limits perfect for testing waters or small-scale use.
Add your payment information in the popup window, and then click Submit
Build a SendGrid MCP Server for AI Email Workflows

issues: Whether a permanent free plan exists is not established by the sources.
Webhook and sandbox support are not clearly stated in readable source text.
No official MCP server is shown; only a community tutorial.

searches.query: SendGrid API credentials pricing plan required developer access
